articles.title: OKX brings OpenAI and Anthropic bets to Europe as pre-IPO trading grows
articles.snippet: The exchange is offering up to 10x leverage on private-company valuations alongside 100 tokenized stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent company Payward at $21 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The investment expands a strategic partnership to bring tokenized, voting-enabled equities to crypto exchange users.

articles.title: Crypto wins regardless of Clarity Act vote, Coinbase's Armstrong says
articles.snippet: Coinbase CEO tells CNBC the crypto industry gets regulatory clarity whether or not the Senate passes the bill on Sept. 15.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
articles.snippet: Secretary Scott Bessent warned that failing to pass the CLARITY Act would send a “troubling signal” about America’s leadership in the digital asset industry.

articles.title: AI Is Solving Math's Best Problems Faster Than They Can Be Replaced, Terence Tao Warns
articles.snippet: The Fields medalist points to a real race between OpenAI and Anthropic as proof: AI can now flatten a hard problem the moment someone starts working on it.
